import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import root

N = 150_000
TARGET_KL = 10.0
TOL = 0.001

counts = np.array([N - 7, 2, 5], dtype=float)
weights = counts / N


def equations(log_q):
    q = np.exp(log_q)
    return np.array([
        np.dot(weights, q) - 1.0,
        np.dot(weights, log_q) + TARGET_KL,
        np.dot(weights, q * log_q) - TARGET_KL,
    ])


initial = np.array([
    np.log(4.535e-5),
    np.log(13_694.5875),
    np.log(24_520.8043),
])

solution = root(equations, initial, method="hybr", options={"xtol": 1e-12})
if not solution.success:
    raise RuntimeError(solution.message)

q = np.exp(solution.x)
dist = np.empty(N, dtype=np.float64)
dist[: int(counts[0])] = q[0] / N
dist[int(counts[0]) : int(counts[0] + counts[1])] = q[1] / N
dist[int(counts[0] + counts[1]) :] = q[2] / N

uniform = np.full(N, 1.0 / N)
forward_kl = np.sum(dist * np.log(dist / uniform))
backward_kl = np.sum(uniform * np.log(uniform / dist))

assert np.isclose(dist.sum(), 1.0, atol=1e-12)
assert np.all(dist > 0)
assert abs(forward_kl - TARGET_KL) <= TOL
assert abs(backward_kl - TARGET_KL) <= TOL

np.save("/app/dist.npy", dist)

print(f"sum={dist.sum():.15f}")
print(f"forward_kl={forward_kl:.12f}")
print(f"backward_kl={backward_kl:.12f}")
